base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    """Complete horizontal color bands by finding their shortest vertical period."""
    n = len(grid)
    if not n:
        return []
    # Each band is a uniform row; zero rows are missing entries.
    known = {i: row[0] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and any(v != 0 for v in row)}
    period = n
    for p in range(1, n + 1):
        by_residue = {}
        valid = True
        for i, color in known.items():
            r = i % p
            if r in by_residue and by_residue[r] != color:
                valid = False
                break
            by_residue[r] = color
        if valid:
            period = p
            break
    pattern = {}
    for i, color in known.items():
        pattern.setdefault(i % period, color)
    # A selected period should have a value for every residue in these tasks.
    # If not, retain the input value where available and use zero otherwise.
    out = []
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        color = pattern.get(i % period, row[0] if row else 0)
        out.append([color] * len(row))
    return out
'''
